note: Fictional incidents for a fictional shop. Times are relative to the build time, so the demo page always looks current.

incidents.title: [Incident] PromptPay payments failing for some customers
incidents.body:
### Severity

SEV2 - Major: A core feature is degraded for many customers

### Affected services

Payments, Public API

### Public title

Some PromptPay payments are failing

### What is happening?

About 18% of PromptPay QR payments time out at the bank callback since the 13:00 deploy. Card payments look fine.

### When did the impact start?

_No response_

comments.body:
/ack
Looking at the payment gateway dashboards.

/link https://grafana.example.com/d/payments Payment gateway dashboard
/update We are investigating failed PromptPay payments. Card payments are not affected.
/note Callback worker pool shrank from 12 to 4 in the 13:00 config change. Rolling back.

/status identified
/update We found the cause, a configuration change in the payment callback service, and are rolling it back. Payments that failed were not charged.

/status monitoring
/update The rollback is complete and new PromptPay payments are succeeding again. We are watching error rates.

incidents.title: [Incident] Website down after CDN certificate expired
incidents.body:
### Severity

SEV1 - Critical: Customers cannot use a core feature

### Affected services

Website

### Public title

Website unavailable

### What is happening?

All browsers show a certificate error on www. The CDN certificate expired at 09:00.

### When did the impact start?

_No response_

comments.body: /update The website is unavailable. We are working on it.

/status identified
/update The security certificate for our website expired. We are issuing a new one.
/note Auto-renew was disabled during the DNS migration in March.

/status monitoring
/update A new certificate is live. Some visitors may need to reload the page.

/status resolved
/update The website is working normally again.

incidents.title: [Incident] LINE order notifications delayed
incidents.body:
### Severity

SEV3 - Minor: Limited impact, or there is a workaround

### Affected services

LINE notifications

### Public title

LINE order notifications are delayed

### What is happening?

The LINE push queue is backed up, messages arrive 20 to 40 minutes late. Orders themselves are fine.

### When did the impact start?

_No response_

comments.body:
/status identified
/update Order confirmations on LINE are arriving late. Orders and payments are not affected.

/status resolved
/update The backlog has cleared and notifications are on time again.

incidents.title: [Incident] Public API returning 502 errors
incidents.body:
### Severity

SEV2 - Major: A core feature is degraded for many customers

### Affected services

Public API, Website

### Public title

Errors when loading products and orders

### What is happening?

Around 30% of API requests return 502 from the load balancer.

### When did the impact start?

_No response_

comments.body: /update Some pages fail to load products or orders. We are investigating.

/status monitoring
/update We added capacity and errors have stopped. We are monitoring.
